lists.content:
This is a remote, non-hands-on Medical Assistant role. You won’t do vitals, draw blood or room patients. You’ll use your Medical Assistant training to keep patient care moving behind the scenes: working with pharmacies, getting prior authorizations, coordinating referrals and making sure patients get the follow-up they need. If you know the clinical side and are great at the administrative work that keeps it running, this role is for you. 

  • Schedule: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday ; 6:30a–5:00p PST; plus holiday rotation

• Pharmacy and prescription support: Work with pharmacies on refills, clarifications and transfers. Help clinicians with prescription workflows.
  • Prior authorizations and referrals: Prepare and submit prior authorizations (e.g., CoverMyMeds), track them until they’re resolved, and coordinate specialist referrals.
  • Scheduling and follow-up outreach: Schedule appointments and reach out to patients so care plans get completed.
  • Communicate with patients and colleagues in a caring, patient-centered way that keeps our virtual care environment supportive.
  • Document every task and communication accurately and thoroughly in the electronic health record (EHR).
  • Spot workflow problems and escalate them when needed.
  • Take part in team huddles and quality initiatives.
  • Follow HIPAA and confidentiality standards at all times.
  • Other duties as assigned.

• Active nationally recognized Medical Assistant certification (ie, CMA, RMA) required
  • 3+ years of medical assistant experience required
  • 1+ year of telemedicine experience required
  • Able to work a fixed Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday schedule, plus assigned rotating holidays that may fall on non-scheduled days required;
  • Openness to occasional weekend or swap coverage preferred
  • Self-directed and dependable as the primary MA on shift, owning the day’s patient queue and making sound decisions about when to escalate
  • A reliable teammate who communicates proactively, documents thoroughly for the next person on shift, and steps in to help cover when needed
  • Experienced with EHRs and healthcare tools such as CoverMyMeds and DocuSign, and quick to adopt new technology, including AI tools
  • Clear, professional verbal and written communication, with a warm patient-facing manner
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, able to prioritize and manage multiple tasks
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and patient privacy practices
  • A quiet, private workspace and reliable high-speed internet

lists.text: About the Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI role
lists.content: We are hiring a Full-Stack Senior Software Engineer across a range of seniority levels to push the frontier of agentic / applied AI in healthcare. As a member of the technical staff on the artificial intelligence engineering team, you will design, build, and ship ML and LLM systems (agentic AI workflows) that directly shape how clinicians and patients interact with our platform. You will work end-to-end: framing the problem, exploring data, training and evaluating models, productionizing inference, and measuring real-world clinical and product impact. The bar is high and the surface area is large; we are looking for engineers who want significant ownership and are excited to operate where research meets production.

• Lead the technical execution of complex AI initiatives, owning the design and delivery of solutions within a product or technical domain while partnering with senior engineers on broader architectural direction.
  • Design, build, train, evaluate and improve advanced machine learning and LLM-based systems for patient and provider-facing products (e.g., conversational AI, personalization, user understanding, clinical decision support, chronic care management).
  • Own problems end-to-end: scope the problem with clinicians and product partners, build datasets and evaluations, iterate on modeling, and ship to production with the right monitoring and guardrails.
  • Develop robust evaluation frameworks — offline benchmarks, human-in-the-loop review, online experiments — that give us confidence our models are safe, accurate, and improving over time.
  • Build and improve the platform that lets the team move quickly: data pipelines, training and inference infrastructure, prompt and model management, and tooling for clinical reviewers.
  • Partner closely with clinicians, product, and engineering to translate medical and operational requirements into ML problems and ship measurable improvements to patient and clinician experience.
  • Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and raise the bar on engineering and scientific rigor. The scope of leadership scales with seniority.
  • Stay close to the literature and the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem; bring back what is most useful for our patients and our team.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Math, or other related technical degree
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering experience with 1+ year building and deploying machine learning systems including generative AI (LLMS), and a clear track record of impact.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to ship reliable, well-tested code in Python (or a comparable language) in a production environment.
  • Practical understanding of modern LLM techniques: prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning, evaluation, and the trade-offs between them.
  • Comfortability working with messy, real-world data and designing evaluations to know whether a system is actually working.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; ability to cross-collaborate with clinicians, product managers, and engineers across disciplines.
  • A bias toward action and ownership: you can take an ambiguous problem, drive it to a result, and bring others along.
  • Care for the mission. You want your work to translate into better health outcomes for real patients.

    • Nice to Have

  • Experience applying ML or LLMs in healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated, high-stakes domain.
  • Experience with clinical NLP, medical knowledge representation, or working with electronic health record data.
  • Experience building agentic systems, tool-using LLMs, in production.
  • Experience scaling ML infrastructure — training pipelines, distributed inference, evaluation platforms — for a small, fast-moving team.
  • Track record of technical leadership: setting direction across teams, mentoring engineers, or publishing influential work.

• High ownership work on problems that matter, with a tight feedback loop from real clinicians and patients.
  • A small, senior team where your work shows up in the product quickly.
  • Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Remote-first, flexible work environment across the U.S.

lists.text: About the Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
lists.content:
A day in the life of a Curai senior full-stack software engineer is spent doing things like:
  • Working across the stack to drive high-leverage projects from concept through to completion
  • Up-leveling the team on something you have expertise in - API or system design, building applications, cloud infrastructure, healthcare data, or something else entirely
  • Working with a diverse multi-disciplinary team that includes software engineers, machine learning researchers, physicians, product managers, and UX researchers
  • Developing new and updating existing user-facing features
  • Collaborating with backend engineers to establish consistent APIs across our services, and good patterns for interactions with our API on the frontend
  • Leading and guiding cross-team, “big picture” application architectural decisions
  • Producing detailed technical specifications and documentation for features
  • Writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for new features
  • Meeting with product owners, AI/ML researchers, doctors, and other stakeholders, using Agile practices to define, negotiate, and estimate features for our applications

We recognize not everyone will have all of these requirements. If you meet most of the criteria below and you’re excited about the opportunity and willing to learn, we’d love to hear from you. You should have:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field preferred 
  • 5-7 years of professional experience as a full-stack engineer owing features from design, to delivery, to continued iteration.
  • Professional experience with React - components, hooks, state management, and performance.
  • Python backend experience, ideally with async frameworks (FastAPI, Starlette)
  • Experience with both NoSQL and relational databases - you know when to reach for DynamoDB vs Postgres, and how to model around access patterns.
  • Comfort with asynchronous workflows - background jobs, retries, idempotency, and eventual consistency.
  • Demonstrated experience raising product excellence using testing as your leverage - e2e coverage, visual regression testing, and CI to ship multiple times daily without fear
  • An understanding of key components of our platform and infrastructure, including AWS, Docker, Terraform, AI / ML technologies, Git, and RESTful services
    •  

    Nice to Have

  • React Native / Expo, or any cross platform mobile experience
  • Visual/snapshot regression testing, Storybook, harness engineering
  • Experience building design systems / component libraries
  • Accessibility (WCAG, screen readers)
  • LLM application experience - streaming, tool calling, eval driven iteration
  • Temporal or other durable execution systems
  • Experience working with healthcare data (CDA/CCD/FHIR) is a definite plus

lists.text: What You'll do as a Senior Software Engineer, Marketing Platform
lists.content:
In a typical day in the life of a Curai Senior Software Engineer, you’ll:
  • Turning priorities from marketing into scoped engineering projects
  • Define funnel events, implement client and server side tracking, and reconcile conversion data with warehouse reporting.
  • Build SQL models and dashboards to examine cost per visit and cohort behavior
  • Support the build pipeline and ClickHouse data behind our MTA tooling
  • Designing, building, and maintaining web features and the APIs and data flows supporting them
  • Investigating site performance, conversion, and data quality issues, then shipping improvements
  • Reviewing code, improving tests and monitoring, and making technical decisions with the broader engineering team

We recognize not everyone will have all of these requirements. If you meet most of the criteria below and you’re excited about the opportunity and willing to learn, we’d love to hear from you. You should have:

  • 4+ years building and maintaining production software, with substantial ownership of web applications, from design, to delivery, to continued iteration.
  • Strong experience with Javascript or Typescript, and a modern web framework such as React and Next.js
  • Experience with shipping fast, accessible landing pages and funnel experiences, including bulk publishing workflows
  • SQL fluency and comfort working with warehouse data
  • A track record of owning production event tracking and measurement, including defining events, instrumenting web and backend systems, validating attribution, and debugging data quality across systems.
  • Solid judgement about web performance, accessibility, testing, and handling sensitive data.
  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field preferred - You should be able to demonstrate a thorough understanding of CS fundamentals
    • Nice to Have
  • Familiarity with headless CMS platforms such as Contentful
  • Experience with experimentation platforms such as Statsig, GrowthBook, LaunchDarkly, or experience building one.
  • Experience working with customer data platforms such as Segment, Ours Privacy
